description: A comparison over a nullable column is itself nullable -- SQL is three-valued, a NULL operand yields NULL, not false

columns.name: is_adult
columns.note: age is nullable, so age >= 18 is NULL (not false) when age IS NULL

name: comparison_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetAdultFlags
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, age >= 18 AS is_adult FROM people
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE people (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, age INTEGER)
